approval: Human: 批准冻结视觉特征探查
scope: Only 680 registered inner images. No backbone updates, outer manifest access, Fold 1/2, residual architecture, joint loss or formal report editing.
dataset_root: D:/成信工科研/人工智能选矿/数据集/mindat_manual_positive_v1

feature_extractor.layer: features followed by existing adaptive average pooling and flatten; pre-dropout
feature_extractor.transform: Existing evaluation Resize(255), CenterCrop(224), RGB, ToTensor, ImageNet normalization; no augmentation
feature_extractor.mode: eval, requires_grad false, inference_mode, deterministic algorithms; BatchNorm running statistics unchanged

preprocessing.pca: Unlabelled centered full SVD, CPU float64; canonical loading signs; no whitening before per-column standardization
preprocessing.standardization: Fit-only means and population standard deviations, floor 1e-8, no stop statistics
preprocessing.padding: E zeros the H block, H zeros the E block, EH uses both. Raw parameter count matched within architecture, active input capacity is NOT matched.
preprocessing.permutation: EH_permuted keeps E and independently shuffles H rows within each subset; fit seed=seed+100000, stop seed=seed+200000; no class conditioning or label access

heads.mlp: Linear(82,64), SiLU, Dropout(0.1), Linear(64,4), 5572 raw parameters
heads.initialization: PyTorch seeded hidden initialization, zero final layer; identical state and minibatch schedule within each architecture/seed across arms
heads.loss: Unweighted four-class cross entropy; no auxiliary, contrastive, risk or role-aware loss

checkpoint_criterion: Earliest minimum raw stopping four-class NLL among epochs 1..30, matching previous development budget; no seed selection
calibration: Additionally fit a positive global temperature on each selected head's fit probabilities only, beta in [1e-6,100], convex derivative and 80 bisection steps; retain both raw and calibrated results, never select a version based on stop
retained_controls: Previous T0, D0, M0, P0 and P1 results, with registered strong-control summary hash; no retraining or method ranking across independent tasks

screening_rules.information_signal: For a fixed architecture, raw EH NLL lower than same-seed E for all 3 seeds by at least 0.005, and mean raw EH NLL lower than mean EH_permuted by at least 0.005. Descriptive feasibility screen, not a mutual-information estimate or significance test.
screening_rules.role_usable_signal: Information screen plus at least one new correct target in every seed, net correct targets >=0 and no more than one extra Ti false target and one extra metallic false target versus frozen p in every seed.
screening_rules.promotion: No automatic promotion. Report both architectures, every seed, all metrics, failed screens and calibration tradeoffs. Any subsequent architecture needs its own design approval and preregistration.

verification: Pin protocol/code/input hashes before execution; image SHA256 and row feature digests; frozen state hash before/after; complete 680-image feature replay; fit-only preprocessing replay; 24 deterministic head-training replays; all prediction tables and fit-only temperature fits replayed
limitations: Repeatedly exposed stopping set, small inner sample, 64D compression and simple learners limit inference. Negative signal cannot prove I(Y;H|E)=0; positive signal cannot prove a new architecture or independent generalization. No industrial recovery, grade or titanomagnetite-specific performance claim.
